$comment: Reference only — this server reads environment variables, it does not load this file. Copy the wanted entries into ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json under mcpServers.web-search.env. Do not add TAVILY_API_KEY as a ${VAR} placeholder in mcp.json: Pi throws on unset substitution before the server starts.

TAVILY_API_KEY.effect: Enables the Tavily account path. Alone it spends nothing: account credits require WEB_SEARCH_ALLOW_QUOTA=1 as well.

WEB_SEARCH_ALLOW_QUOTA.effect: 1 permits account-credit deep search. Default 0 keeps deep mode on the free keyless tier.

WEB_SEARCH_DEADLINE_MS.effect: Whole-search budget in milliseconds, clamped to 1000..120000. Default 30000.
